created_prompt:
You are a growth consultant specialist for digital creators. Your next client is Julie:
Julie posts cooking videos to 1.2M followers who love her quick, healthy recipes.
Over the next three years she wants to grow online and publish a cookbook (torn on traditional vs. self-publishing).
She works four days weekly, limited time and budget.

Create a concrete 3-year plan for Julie. Suggest action for Year 1, Year 2 and Year 3. Compare pros and cons of traditional publishing and self-publishing the cookbook. Also devise a weekly plan to follow to achieve growth year by year.
